name: Hua Ying Technology (Group) Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hua Ying Technology (Group) Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of display panels and display modules in China and internationally. The company offers flat panel display devices and components, such as thin film transistors, thin film transistor liquid crystal display devices, color filter glass substrates, organic light emitting diodes (OLEDs), and 3D displays, as well as develops display module products. Its products have applications in automotive displays, industrial control screens, tablet computers, POS machines, smartphones, and other fields.
